$comment: The cross-process lock of src/util.mjs (acquireLock, acquireLockAsync, withLock, lockHolder) and every other exclusive-create file or pid marker in src/*.mjs and mcctl.mjs. A Rust writer (rust/crates/spawnloft-lib/src/lock.rs) and a Node writer must exclude each other on these files. test/contracts-locks.test.mjs holds the constants and the record against util.mjs and fails on a call site not listed here; test/lock-cross-process.test.mjs runs Node against the Rust lock. Prose: EXCLUSION.md.

record.written: JSON.stringify({ pid, token }): the keys in that order, no whitespace, no trailing newline
record.token: crypto.randomUUID(): a lowercase RFC 4122 version 4 UUID, new for every try
record.readAs: utf8, then String.prototype.trim (which strips a BOM)
record.legacy: text matching ^\d+$ after the trim is a bare pid (1.x), with no token
record.valid: JSON whose pid is an integer above 0; anything else, or an empty file, is unwritten

rules.liveness: the pid only, never the program: process.kill(pid, 0), EPERM counts as alive, a pid that is not a 32-bit integer is dead
rules.release: token-checked: the file is removed only while it parses to a record whose token equals the holder's (a legacy record never matches)

breaker.content: the breaker's pid as decimal text, no newline
breaker.rule: only the process that created the breaker may remove a stale lock, and only if the lock still reads byte for byte as when it was judged dead; a breaker older than staleMs is removed by whoever meets it, who then reports the lock as held for this try

messages.timedOut: timed out waiting for lock ${file} (held by pid ${holder})
messages.notGot: could not get a lock on ${file}

sites.protects: putInstance: read-modify-write of instances.json
updateInstance: read-modify-write of instances.json
removeInstance: read-modify-write of instances.json
data move refuses while the registry is being changed (-1 counts as held)
read-modify-write of ops.json, banned-players.json, whitelist.json of a stopped server
read-modify-write of schedules.json; a timeout becomes 'another change to the scheduled tasks is still in progress'; re-entrant within one call chain by a depth counter
two starts of one server both reading 'not running' and spawning two daemons; held until the daemon publishes state.json
data move refuses while a server is being started
one snapshot per server at a time (save-off / save-on pairing), queued not refused
data move refuses while a backup runs
launch: two Play clicks or panel plus CLI starting two games; held until state.json names the game
removeProfile: a launch recreating the run folder after a purge
renameProfile while a launch is under way
updateProfile refuses to change running keys during a launch (-1 counts as held)
the pid in the 'is being launched (pid N)' message; null and -1 print '?'
read-modify-write of client/runtime/index.json shared by every Java runtime

lines: const release = await acquireLockAsync(path.join(RUNTIME_DIR, component, `${platform}.lock`), { timeoutMs: 15 * 60000 })
sites.protects: laying out one Mojang Java runtime (two profiles launched together)
extracting one version's natives folder
Forge/NeoForge loader builds for one Minecraft version; retried in 500 ms turns up to 30 minutes so a cancel ends the wait
withLock itself

lines: const body = JSON.stringify({ pid: process.pid, token })
sites.protects: tryLock's exclusive create of the record
breakStaleLock: clearing a stale lock is itself exclusive

lines: if (err.code === 'EEXIST') fail(`Redis installation is already in progress. If it was interrupted, close SpawnLoft and remove ${lock}, then retry.`)
exclusive.record: empty, mode 0600, held open until the install ends, then unlinked
exclusive.stale: none: a crash leaves it until the user removes it (the message says so)
exclusive.readBy: nobody reads it; its existence refuses a second install

lines: if (err.code === 'EEXIST') fail(`MySQL installation is already in progress. If a previous installation was interrupted, close SpawnLoft and remove ${lock}, then retry.`)
exclusive.record: empty, mode 0600, held open until the install ends, then unlinked
created empty, then tar's output; renamed to .tar.gz when verified, removed on failure
exclusive.stale: none in the lock sense: an existing .pending (or .tar.gz or .json) moves the reservation to the next _N; uninstall removes stamped leftovers

exclusive.record: the joined SQL dump, renamed to .sql when complete, removed in finally
exclusive.stale: none: the base name is chosen first by existsSync on .sql; an existing .pending fails the dump
exclusive.readBy: nobody but its writer; uninstall removes stamped leftovers

exclusive.stale: the folder is removed in finally

exclusive.record: base64url of 32 random bytes and a newline; made private before the key is written; published by hard link, or exclusive create where links fail
exclusive.stale: none: first creator wins, everyone reads the winner (a reader waits up to 2 s for an empty file to fill)

a copy of a damaged settings.json

exclusive.path: any destination of a tree copy (data move, server copy)

lines: fs.writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify({ pid: process.pid, at: new Date().toISOString() }))
markers.record: {"pid":<pid>,"at":"<ISO 8601>"} from JSON.stringify: no whitespace, no newline; plain write, not exclusive (beginRestore checks isRestoring first, so two restores racing in the same instant can both pass)
markers.stale: ignored unless pid is an integer and pidAlive(pid); not removed by readers
markers.readBy: control.mjs isRestoring / restoreBlock / activeBlock (start, delete, rename, restore, database backup and delete)

lines: try { writeJson(stopMark(name), { pid: state.pid, at: new Date().toISOString() }) } catch { /* the in-process mark still holds */ }
markers.record: writeJson: JSON.stringify(x, null, 2) + newline via <file>.tmp and rename; {pid: the game's pid, at: ISO 8601}
markers.stale: matches only the game whose pid it names; removed by the launcher before a new game and when the game exits, and by stop when the game did not stop
